week_1.description: Building movement foundation and establishing routine with bodyweight exercises

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Keep body straight from head to heels. Lower chest to floor, push up explosively.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Compound upper body movement stimulates growth hormone release

exercises.name: Pike Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Start in downward dog position. Lower head toward floor between hands.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Inverted position improves circulation and hormone transport

exercises.name: Tricep Dips (chair/bench)
exercises.form_tips: Hands on edge of chair, legs extended. Lower body by bending elbows.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Tricep strength supports compound pressing movements

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.form_tips: Maintain straight line from head to heels. Engage core and glutes.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Core stability improves overall strength and hormone production

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.form_tips: Start in plank position. Alternate bringing knees to chest rapidly.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: High-intensity cardio boosts testosterone levels

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.form_tips: Feet shoulder-width apart. Lower until thighs parallel to floor.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Large muscle group activation triggers hormone response

exercises.name: Alternating Lunges
exercises.form_tips: Step forward, lower back knee toward floor. Front thigh parallel to ground.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Unilateral strength builds functional power

exercises.name: Single-leg Glute Bridges
exercises.form_tips: Lie on back, one foot on floor. Lift hips by squeezing glutes.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Glute activation crucial for hormone production

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.form_tips: Back against wall, slide down to 90-degree angle. Keep knees over ankles.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Isometric holds create metabolic stress

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.form_tips: Rise up on toes, hold briefly. Lower slowly with control.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Lower leg strength supports compound movements

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.form_tips: Squat down, jump back to plank. Do push-up, jump feet to hands, jump up.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Full-body explosive movement maximizes hormone response

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.form_tips: Perform regular squat. Explode up into jump. Land softly.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Plyometric power development

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.form_tips: Run in place bringing knees to chest. Pump arms actively.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Cardio intensity boosts T levels

exercises.name: Push-up to T
exercises.form_tips: Perform push-up. Rotate to side plank, arm up. Return.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Rotational power and stability

exercises.name: Plank Jacks
exercises.form_tips: Hold plank position. Jump feet apart and together. Keep core engaged.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Core power with cardio element

week_2.description: Increasing intensity and adding a fourth training day for progressive overload

exercises.name: Diamond Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Hands together forming diamond shape. Lower chest to hands.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Increased tricep activation and intensity

exercises.name: Handstand Hold (wall)
exercises.form_tips: Kick up to wall. Keep arms straight, core tight.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Inverted position boosts circulation and hormone transport

exercises.name: Wide-grip Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Hands wider than shoulders. Focus on chest stretch at bottom.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Chest development enhances overall T production

exercises.name: Side Plank (each side)
exercises.form_tips: Stack feet, lift hips. Keep body in straight line.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Lateral core strength and stability

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.form_tips: Hands and feet on ground, knees hovering. Move forward slowly.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Full body coordination and metabolic demand

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
exercises.form_tips: Rear foot elevated on chair. Lower until front thigh parallel.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Unilateral overload for maximum muscle activation

exercises.name: Sumo Squats
exercises.form_tips: Wide stance, toes pointed out. Lower hips straight down.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Inner thigh and glute activation

exercises.name: Step-ups (chair)
exercises.form_tips: Step onto sturdy chair. Drive through heel. Control descent.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Functional strength and power development

exercises.name: Glute Bridge March
exercises.form_tips: Hold bridge position. Alternate lifting knees to chest.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Glute endurance and hip stability

exercises.name: Jump Lunges
exercises.form_tips: Lunge position, jump and switch legs mid-air. Land softly.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Explosive power and plyometric development

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.form_tips: Hands behind head. Bring opposite elbow to knee. Extend other leg.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Core activation supports compound movement strength

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.form_tips: Lean back slightly, feet off ground. Rotate torso side to side.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Rotational core power

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.form_tips: Lie flat, hands under hips. Raise legs to 90 degrees. Lower slowly.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Lower ab activation and hip flexor strength

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.form_tips: Lie face down. Lift arms and legs simultaneously. Squeeze back.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Posterior chain activation

exercises.name: Burpee to Tuck Jump
exercises.form_tips: Standard burpee but jump with knees to chest at top.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Maximum intensity full-body movement

day_4.name: Full Body Strength

exercises.name: Decline Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Feet elevated on chair. Hands on floor. Lower chest to ground.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Increased upper chest and shoulder activation

exercises.name: Pistol Squat Progression
exercises.form_tips: Hold onto support. Lower on one leg. Use assistance as needed.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Maximum single-leg strength development

exercises.name: Pike Push-ups (elevated)
exercises.form_tips: Feet on chair in pike position. Lower head toward floor.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Shoulder strength approaching handstand push-up

exercises.name: Single-leg Deadlift
exercises.form_tips: Stand on one leg. Hinge forward, reaching toward floor. Keep back flat.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Posterior chain and balance development

exercises.name: Explosive Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Push up explosively so hands leave ground. Land softly.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Power development and fast-twitch fiber recruitment

cooldown: Full Body Stretch (30s each major muscle)

week_3.description: Introducing explosive movements and increasing volume for maximum testosterone response

exercises.name: Clap Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Push up explosively, clap hands, land softly. Modify on knees if needed.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Maximum power output and fast-twitch recruitment

exercises.name: Archer Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Wide hand position. Shift weight to one arm while extending other.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Unilateral pressing strength approaching one-arm push-up

exercises.name: Handstand Push-up (wall)
exercises.form_tips: Kick up to wall. Lower head to floor. Push back up.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Maximum shoulder strength and overhead pressing power

exercises.name: Dip Hold (max time)
exercises.form_tips: Support body on parallel surfaces. Hold top position with locked arms.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Isometric strength builds tendon resilience

exercises.name: Plank to Push-up
exercises.form_tips: Start on forearms. Push up to hands one arm at a time. Alternate leading arm.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Transitional strength and core stability

exercises.name: Box Jumps (or step)
exercises.form_tips: Jump onto sturdy elevated surface. Land softly with bent knees. Step down.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Explosive power and maximum muscle fiber recruitment

exercises.name: Pistol Squats
exercises.form_tips: Extend one leg forward. Lower on standing leg. Use support if needed.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Maximum single-leg strength and balance

exercises.name: Broad Jumps
exercises.form_tips: Swing arms back, explode forward. Land softly with bent knees.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Horizontal power development

exercises.name: Nordic Curl Progression
exercises.form_tips: Kneel, anchor feet. Lower body forward slowly. Push back up from floor.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Eccentric hamstring strength

exercises.name: Squat Jump to Lunge
exercises.form_tips: Jump squat, land in lunge position. Alternate sides.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Complex movement pattern for maximum metabolic demand

exercises.name: Dragon Flags (progression)
exercises.form_tips: Lie on bench, grip behind head. Raise body as one unit. Lower slowly.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Advanced core strength and full-body tension

exercises.name: L-Sit Hold (floor)
exercises.form_tips: Hands on floor beside hips. Lift body, extend legs forward.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Hip flexor and core isometric strength

exercises.name: Windshield Wipers
exercises.form_tips: Lie on back, legs up. Lower legs side to side with control.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Rotational core power and oblique strength

exercises.name: Tuck Planche Hold
exercises.form_tips: Hands on floor, lean forward. Tuck knees to chest, lift feet.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Advanced pushing strength and body control

exercises.name: Sprint Intervals
exercises.form_tips: All-out effort for 20 seconds. Walk or jog during rest.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: HIIT sprints are proven to boost testosterone significantly

exercises.name: Burpee Pull-up (or jump)
exercises.form_tips: Perform burpee under bar. Jump to pull-up or high reach at top.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Maximum full-body power output

exercises.name: Explosive Step-ups
exercises.form_tips: Step up explosively, driving knee up at top. Switch legs.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Single-leg explosive power

exercises.name: Decline Diamond Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Feet elevated, hands in diamond. Maximum tricep and chest activation.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Advanced pressing strength

exercises.name: Jumping Lunges
exercises.form_tips: Lunge position, jump and switch. Land softly in opposite lunge.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Plyometric leg power

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.form_tips: Lie on back. Lift shoulders and legs. Press lower back to floor.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Deep core activation and gymnastic strength

week_4.description: Maximum intensity week combining all skills learned for peak testosterone and fitness response

exercises.name: One-Arm Push-up Progression
exercises.form_tips: Wide stance for balance. Lower on one arm. Use elevation to modify.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Maximum unilateral pressing strength

exercises.name: Handstand Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Wall-supported. Full range of motion. Head to floor and back up.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Peak overhead pressing power

exercises.name: Muscle-up Progression
exercises.form_tips: Explosive pull-up transitioning over bar. Use jump assist if needed.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Full upper body pulling and pushing power

exercises.name: Planche Lean Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Lean forward past hands in push-up. Increased shoulder demand.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Advanced pushing strength and body control

exercises.name: Typewriter Push-ups
exercises.form_tips: Wide push-up position. Shift to one side at bottom. Push back up.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Lateral pressing strength and chest development

exercises.name: Pistol Squats (full)
exercises.form_tips: No assistance. Full depth on one leg. Arms forward for balance.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Peak single-leg strength achievement

exercises.name: Depth Jumps
exercises.form_tips: Step off box, land, immediately jump as high as possible.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Reactive power and nervous system activation

exercises.name: Shrimp Squats
exercises.form_tips: Hold rear foot behind you. Lower knee to floor. Stand back up.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Advanced single-leg strength variation

exercises.name: Nordic Curls (full)
exercises.form_tips: Kneel, anchor feet. Lower body forward with control. Full range.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Peak eccentric hamstring strength

exercises.name: Broad Jump + Vertical Jump
exercises.form_tips: Broad jump forward, immediately jump vertically. Maximum effort.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Complex plyometric power development

exercises.name: Dragon Flags (full)
exercises.form_tips: Full body as one unit. Lower slowly with control. No arching.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Peak core strength and full-body tension

exercises.name: L-Sit (full, 15-30s)
exercises.form_tips: Legs fully extended and parallel to floor. Shoulders depressed.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Advanced isometric core and hip flexor strength

exercises.name: Front Lever Progression
exercises.form_tips: Hang from bar. Raise body to horizontal. Use tuck to modify.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Full posterior chain activation under tension

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollouts (or towel)
exercises.form_tips: Kneel, roll forward extending body. Pull back with core. No hip sag.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Anti-extension core strength

exercises.name: Tabata Sprints
exercises.form_tips: Maximum effort sprints. True all-out intensity each round.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Tabata protocol proven to maximize testosterone and growth hormone

exercises.name: Muscle-up or Explosive Pull-up
exercises.form_tips: Pull explosively above bar. Transition to dip position. Lower with control.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Ultimate upper body pulling power

exercises.name: Pistol Squat to Box Jump
exercises.form_tips: Pistol squat, stand, immediately box jump. Maximum power chain.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Complex movement for peak leg power

exercises.name: Handstand Push-up + Walk
exercises.form_tips: Perform HSPU then walk on hands along wall.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Peak shoulder strength and body control

exercises.name: Burpee Muscle-up
exercises.form_tips: Burpee under bar, jump to muscle-up. Ultimate full-body movement.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Maximum power output combining all movement patterns

exercises.name: Sprint Finisher
exercises.form_tips: All-out 100m sprints. Full recovery between. Leave nothing in the tank.
exercises.testosterone_benefit: Sprint training is the ultimate testosterone booster
